title: Remina
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Professor Oguro discovers a planet emerging from a wormhole and names it after his daughter Remina, who becomes a celebrity. When the planet begins devouring stars and heads for Earth, panicked mobs and a masked cult blame the girl and hunt her. Junji Ito's one-volume cosmic horror won the 2021 Eisner for Best U.S. Edition of International Material, Asia.
life_message: Under terror, crowds turn on the innocent; fame and human decency are fragile.

content.note: Mob beating, stabbing, crucifixion, whipping and torture of Remina and others (Wikipedia); MangaUpdates Torture; AniList Body Horror.
Planet-scale cosmic horror and grotesque body transformations (Wikipedia; AniList Cosmic Horror and Body Horror tags).
Kunihiro sexually assaults Remina in the shelter (Wikipedia); explicitness to verify; MangaDex safe.
Mass panic and despair (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy).
Scapegoating and mob justice shown as monstrous.
